_comment: The site termbase (DOC-EXTERNAL-QUALITY rule 4, ticket 059): the few terms this
corpus must keep consistent, checked against the rendered pages by
tools/Test-SiteQuality.ps1. 'stems' are accepted substrings per locale,
a term's approved form must appear somewhere in the pages of its scope for each
locale that has pages there. 'forbidden' substrings must not appear in those pages
at all. 'everyPage' terms must hit on every public page, title text included.
Scope 'lang' looks at the two pages of each locale under lang/; scope 'guides'
looks at the English task guides, whose RU and UA spans carry the Russian and Ukrainian text.
The product name of the Android reader app is FastMediaSorter - one word - and is
a legitimate string on publish-folders-android.html, so it is not forbidden here.
Bold text on a guide page (the guides write an interface name in bold) must be the product's own string in that
language - a key or a translation in src/Localization or the Share Manager's tables - or be listed here. Listed
here means: it is bold but not an interface name of THIS program: a file extension, another product's or the
phone app's control, an installer string, a heading or a phrase. A new bold phrase that is not an interface name
is added here on purpose; an entry no guide uses any more fails the check, so the list cannot rot (specification 157, T-2).
Strings are lower-cased, quotes and one trailing '..' or ':' removed. 'any' applies to every language.
